answer: Counterparty-diversity threshold: paid work needs 20 distinct counterparties in 10 epochs. Each deal leaves a public thread on the graph, so a farm's threads loop back to one owner. At dawn an audit samples the threads; clusters fail the count and the slot dies. Forging 20 costs 15 POA each, so 100 fakes cost 30,000 POA for a 5,000 POA share, a loss. Honest agents pay nothing extra: their river of trades spans many hands; rewards stay whole.
